answers.text: The manual lists “Clear*; see Technical Data on pages 24–27” as the solution; it does not prescribe consulting the Technical Data as an inspection or test.
answers.rationale: Both troubleshooting rows give clearing as the solution and refer to the Technical Data, but neither states that consulting it is a check or test.

answers.text: The manual lists “Exhausted fluid supply” as the cause, but does not state that it affects a component called “Fluid supply.”
answers.rationale: The table identifies exhausted fluid supply as the cause of erratic or accelerated pump speed, but does not assert the proposed component relationship.
The stated cause is air leaking into the supply container, which supports that this failure mode affects the supply container.
